scientific_integrity: Proof and supporting executable checks supplied. Originality is conditional on inspected literature and vulnerable to unpublished or unindexed equivalent weighted spectral-comparison results. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Positive C1 reflection-symmetric weights; complex L2; no claim of strict finite Ky Fan inequalities or individual singular-value monotonicity; general weights have only the transfer characteristic equation and a nonsymmetric counterexample. Historical unweighted spectral roots are known.
title: Radial singular-value majorization for reflection-symmetric weighted integration
